<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈193.079 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈13 % M+1 and ≈33 % M+2) suggests about 12 carbons and the presence of a single chlorine atom. A formula that matches the exact mass is C₁₂H₁₄Cl (exact mass 193.0784 Da), which is within typical instrument error and explains the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H14Cl</final_answer>
